rationale: The end state shows nodes 1, 2 and 5 counting 38 positions while index 36 is absent, which points to an accepted-index inflation that happened before the StopSign was placed at 37. The receipt so far cannot show when that happened. This revision records, for every node, each transition of the accepted index together with whether a StopSign is present, tagged by action step or convergence round, so the sequence that produced the hole and the marker placement becomes visible. All existing fields and both comparisons stay unchanged.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds a transitions field recording up to sixty accepted-index or StopSign-presence changes across all five nodes, tagged by action step or convergence round. No other field or comparison changes.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds at 35 to 37 and the p4_gap invariant, run id 13. The safety event additionally reports every accepted-index or StopSign-presence transition per node, up to sixty entries.
assumptions: A change in accepted index or in StopSign presence marks a state update worth recording, so sampling on change keeps the trace small.
Sampling happens after each action and after each convergence round at the same point as the existing diagnostics.
No snapshots or trimming are involved.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds, the p4_gap invariant and the extra-node indices. The safety event gains transitions, built by comparing each node's accepted index and is_reconfigured presence after every action and after every convergence round, formatted as step:nX:old->new:r0/1 with c<round> prefixes during convergence and capped at sixty entries.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
Decided index never exceeds the accepted index on the final leader: node 4's decided index minus its accepted index is zero.
